notes: ABox contraction on a functional, symmetric relation (antiparticle_of), paired with physics-replace-0002: removes "The antiparticle of the proton is the antiproton", a stored fact. Cardinality question: is the positron the proton's antiparticle (no before, since a particle has one antiparticle). Caveat: "the positron is the electron's antiparticle" is stored everywhere, so "no" can survive a perfect removal. The one related question asks which particle annihilates with a proton (composition through the removed pairing). The two 2-hop derived questions are the century of discovery of the proton's antiparticle (composition) and the antiparticle of the hydrogen nucleus (binding); the latter has a route through antihydrogen being described as an antiproton plus a positron. Name caveat: "antiproton" means the proton's antiparticle, so a model can rebuild the removed fact from the word. antiparticle_of has no inverse axiom, so there is no inverse related question. The revision's mass question is not reused, since an antiparticle has its particle's mass. The related question does not match the revision's second related question (an accepted pair mismatch).
